ploidyspec report: SchYoun1

Summary

Structure in this individual's assembly, read from the sections below; not inheritance and not origin. See docs/guide, Chapter 6.

Ploidy

4 haplotype copies of each of 25 chromosome numbers; no older duplicated sets detected.

Confidence: high. Evidence: copies from the assembly (4 per number)

Auto-like or allo-like?

Mixed: tetrasomic-like and split chromosomes in one genome (see rediploidization).

Confidence: medium. Evidence: 25 chromosome numbers assessed: 10 split into lineages, 14 tetrasomic-like, 0 one divergent copy, 1 candidate

TE markers

Repeat history does not track the copies' lineages (no within-genome TE contrast).

Confidence: medium. Evidence: TE split >= 2 on 0/15 chromosomes (median 1.06); absolute te_marker_fraction 0.2227 (reference only)

Rediploidization

Yes: 5 chromosome fusion(s) between copies, which separate fused and unfused lineages (the snow carp mechanism).

Confidence: high. Evidence: 5 fusion(s): chr04+chr15, chr08+chr16, chr11+chr14, chr19+chr22, chr20+chr23; 10 split / 14 tetrasomic-like chromosomes; 1 regional split(s); homeology map: 0% of the genome in 0 homeolog blocks, 0 chromosome pairs

Copy number and copy divergence (whole-chromosome matrix)

Hierarchically reordered, chromosome-number resolution

Same distance data as the heatmaps above, but collapsed to one value per chromosome NUMBER (haplotype copies aggregated away) and reordered by average-linkage clustering -- shows cross-chromosome (subgenome/ancestral-pair) structure cleanly, including diffuse structure with no individually FDR-significant pair. Red outlines mark individually FDR-accepted pairs from the homeolog test below. See INTERPRETATION.md's "checkerboard" section.
